card.name: Commas in book citations
card.fires_on: The comma right after a publisher's city (Philadelphia, Provo, Cambridge, München) or after an editor name or book title in a bibliography reference.

modes.label: Comma after publication city
modes.description: Comma following a city name before the state and publisher in a citation.

modes.label: Comma after editor or title
modes.description: Comma after an editor's name or a book title, before 'ed.' or an edition note.
modes.example: use this source: - Hagelweide, Gert<<,>> ed. Deutsche Zeitungsbestände in

card.plain: It fires on the comma in a reference list entry, usually right after the city where a book was published.
